en.title: Medical Practice Assistant, Health Professional or Medical Secretary
en.description:
Emmental Hospital ensures high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents at its two hospital locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, 24 hours a day.

At the heart of life. At the heart of action. Together, we shape tomorrow’s future. Are you looking for more than just a job, but a meaningful task? Then you’re in the right place with us!

For our Pneumology practice at the locations in Burgdorf and/or Langnau, we are looking for someone starting from August 1, 2026 or upon agreement:

Emmental Hospital ensures high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents at its two hospital locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, 24 hours a day.

At the heart of life. At the heart of action. Together, we shape tomorrow’s future. Are you looking for more than just a job, but a meaningful task? Then you’re in the right place with us!

Your tasks – diverse and responsible

• You care for our patients with joy and heart: you plan appointments, are their first point of contact, and ensure warm and professional care
• You keep things running smoothly: you ensure our appointments run efficiently and without issues
• You handle the administrative work: administrative preparation of appointments is your responsibility, reliable and forward-thinking. You write precise reports from dictation
• You contribute actively: you conduct pulmonary function tests and simple sleep studies and explain their process to patients
• You bring your medical expertise practically: you perform blood draws (venous and arterial), administer infusions, conduct skin tests, and assist during bronchoscopies. If interested, you can learn these procedures here, but it’s not a requirement

Your profile – professionally skilled and humanly convincing

• You possess medical expertise: you have a completed education as a Medical Practice Assistant, Health Professional EFZ, Medical Secretary, or another medical/paramedical education
• You impress as a personality: engaged, open-minded, and team-oriented—so you work and actively bring your organizational skills
• You meet people on an equal footing: respect and appreciation define your approach. You are open, communicative, and empathetic
• You work reliably: independent, responsible, and structured work defines you
• You enrich our team: with a healthy dose of humor, you contribute to a positive and motivated work environment

Our offer
Ferias: Do we have special vacation plans? If the annual 25 to 32 vacation days don’t suffice, we can explore the possibility of an unpaid vacation day. Additionally, for your birthday, you’ll receive an extra free day!
GAV: Our employment terms are based on the collective labor agreement (GAV) for personnel of Bernese Hospitals and Clinics.
Culinary: Our kitchens in Burgdorf and Langnau use largely seasonal, healthy, and local products. Employees benefit from discounts and can enjoy a varied buffet selection. Microwaves for self-brought food are also available.
Modernidad, humanidad y participación activa: We want to be a modern employer, creating a positive interpersonal atmosphere so that our employees always feel central and at ease.
Parking: Employees can use various parking lots depending on the location. Access and billing are handled via Parkingpay card.
Events: To promote our corporate culture, we offer a free day. Colleagues from various departments can participate in skiing, cycling, train rides, hiking, fun events, Christmas markets, or cultural events.
Discounts: On our intranet, you’ll find information/links to numerous attractive offers and benefit from reduced prices, such as for swimming pools, cinemas, cars, or purchases in regional pharmacies.

Development opportunities: Do you want to develop further? We can offer you the path to becoming a Senior Medical Practice Assistant.

A varied workday: You’ll find a job with diversity—no day is the same.

No boredom: You work in a dynamic, exciting environment that’s always in motion.

A well-structured team: You’ll find a motivated, warm, and supportive team that looks forward to your presence.

Clear structures: Regulated working hours without weekend shifts provide reliable planning and a good work-life balance.

If you enjoy diverse tasks, work independently, and want to be part of a dynamic team, then you’re in the right place with us!

Au cœur de la vie. Au cœur de l'action. Avec nous, construisons l'avenir de demain. Cherchez pas seulement un emploi, mais une mission avec sens ? Alors, vous êtes chez nous au bon endroit !

Pour notre cabinet de pneumologie aux sites de Burgdorf et/ou Langnau, nous recherchons à partir du 1er août 2026 ou selon accord une:

L'Hôpital Emmental assure une prestation médicale de haute qualité pour 150 000 habitants aux deux sites hospitaliers de Burgdorf et Langnau, 24 heures sur 24.

Au cœur de la vie. Au cœur de l'action. Avec nous, construisons l'avenir de demain. Cherchez pas seulement un emploi, mais une mission avec sens ? Alors, vous êtes chez nous au bon endroit !

Vos missions – variées et responsables

• Vous accompagnez nos patient(e)s avec enthousiasme et affection : vous planifiez les consultations, êtes leur première personne de contact et assurez une prise en charge chaleureuse et professionnelle
• Vous assurez le bon fonctionnement : vous garantissez que les consultations se déroulent sans encombre et efficacement
• Vous gérez l'administration : la préparation administrative des consultations est à votre charge, fiable et préventive. Vous rédigez précisément les comptes-rendus à partir de la dictée
• Vous participez activement : vous réalisez des tests de fonction respiratoire et des études de sommeil simples et expliquez leur déroulement aux patient(e)s
• Vous apportez votre expertise médicale de manière pratique : vous effectuez des prélèvements sanguins (veineux et artériel), administrez des perfusions, réalisez des tests cutanés et assistez lors de bronchoscopies. Si vous êtes intéressé(e), vous pouvez apprendre ces procédures ici, mais ce n’est pas une condition obligatoire

Votre profil – compétent et humainement convaincant

• Vous possédez une expertise médicale : vous avez une formation achevée comme Assistant(e) médical(e) en cabinet, Profession de santé EFZ, Secrétaire médicale ou une autre formation médicale ou paramédicale
• Vous impressionnez par votre personnalité : engagée, ouverte et orientée équipe – ainsi, vous travaillez et apportez activement votre sens de l’organisation
• Vous rencontrez les personnes à hauteur : le respect et l’appréciation définissent votre manière de traiter. Vous êtes ouverte, communicative et empathique
• Vous travaillez de manière fiable : un travail indépendant, responsable et structuré vous caractérise
• Vous enrichissez notre équipe : avec une bonne dose d’humour, vous contribuez à un environnement de travail positif et motivant

Notre offre

• Vacances : Des plans de vacances spéciaux ? Si les 25 à 32 jours de vacances annuels ne suffisent pas, nous pouvons examiner la possibilité d’un jour de congé non rémunéré. De plus, pour votre anniversaire, vous obtiendrez un jour supplémentaire de congé !
• GAV : Nos conditions d’emploi se basent sur le contrat collectif de travail (GAV) pour le personnel des hôpitaux et cliniques de la région de Berne.
• Cuisine : Nos cuisines à Burgdorf et Langnau utilisent principalement des produits saisonniers, sains et locaux. Les employés bénéficient d’une réduction et peuvent se régaler d’une large sélection de buffets.
• Modernité, humanité et participation active : Nous voulons être un employeur moderne, créer une atmosphère interpersonnelle positive, afin que nos employés se sentent toujours au cœur de la vie et à l’aise.
• Parking : Les employés peuvent utiliser divers parkings selon le lieu. L’accès et la facturation se font via la carte Parkingpay.
• Événements : Pour promouvoir notre culture d’entreprise, nous offrons un jour de congé. Des collègues de différentes sections peuvent participer à des journées de ski, de vélo, de train, de randonnée, de divertissement, de marché de Noël ou d’événements culturels.
• Réductions : Sur notre intranet, vous trouverez des informations/liens vers de nombreuses offres attractives et bénéficiez de prix réduits, par exemple pour piscine, cinéma, voiture ou pour des achats en pharmacies régionales.

Opportunités de développement : Voulez-vous vous développer davantage ? Nous pouvons vous offrir la possibilité de devenir Assistant(e) médical(e) en cabinet supérieur.

Un jour de travail varié : Vous attendez un emploi avec diversité, aucun jour n’est identique à un autre.

Aucune chance de lassitude : Vous travaillez dans un environnement dynamique, passionnant et toujours en mouvement.

Une équipe bien structurée : Vous trouverez une équipe motivée, chaleureuse et soutenante qui attend avec enthousiasme votre présence.

Structures claires : Des horaires de travail régulés sans service le week-end vous offrent une planification fiable et une bonne conciliation vie professionnelle/vie privée.

Si vous aimez les tâches variées, travaillez de manière autonome et souhaitez faire partie d’une équipe dynamique, alors vous êtes chez nous au bon endroit !

en.title: Nutrition Consultant (BSc)
en.description:
Emmental Hospital ensures high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents at its two locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, 24 hours a day.

What sets us apart:

A varied and stimulating workday: You will individually accompany patients in outpatient and inpatient care and apply your therapeutic expertise directly. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to participate in projects and lectures. Interdisciplinary collaboration is key for us: together, we achieve the best results for our patients.

For nutrition counseling at the Burgdorf and Langnau locations, we are immediately hiring a nutrition consultant with a Bachelor’s degree in Nutrition and Dietetics (BSc), on a permanent basis.

Your tasks:

• Conduct outpatient consultations across various fields and accompany patients individually;
• Perform inpatient nutrition therapies in various areas (oral, enteral, parenteral);
• In collaboration with physicians, develop tailored nutrition strategies that actively contribute to improving treatment outcomes;
• Student care;
• Conduct lectures within the framework of projects or outpatient rehabilitation (e.g., pulmonary and cardiac rehabilitation);
• Participation in projects.

Your profile – what you bring:

• Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Nutrition and Dietetics;
• Ready to work at both locations in Burgdorf and Langnau;
• Interdisciplinary teamwork is natural and enriching for you;
• You are an active team player who willingly supports colleagues;
• You are a committed, service-oriented personality who accompanies patients with competence and empathy.

• Holidays: Additional unpaid leave options if the annual 25–32 days are insufficient.

Le tue mansioni

• Come Professionista Sanitario in Psichiatria accompagni le nostre pazienti e pazienti e coinvolgi anche i loro familiari
• In questo contesto svolgi compiti variati nei settori di attivazione, gestione della vita quotidiana e delle relazioni, assistenza, ristorazione e amministrazione e supporti persone con disturbi psichici secondo le loro esigenze e situazioni quotidiane
• Ad esempio, ti occupi della cura quotidiana del corpo, dell'alzarsi, dell'abbigliamento, delle uscite, del shopping, della cucina o nella gestione della loro vita quotidiana
• Assumi anche compiti tecnico-medici come il misurare la pressione sanguigna, il polso e la temperatura, prelievi di sangue e somministrazione di farmaci

Che cosa hai

• Devi avere almeno 17 anni all'inizio dell'apprendistato
• Devi avere un elevato senso dell'empatia, un atteggiamento rispettoso e buone capacità comunicative
• Devi lavorare bene in squadra e avere un alto senso della responsabilità
• Devi avere buone conoscenze della lingua italiana
• Devi essere flessibile e essere disposto/a a svolgere parte della formazione in Burgdorf o Langnau

I tuoi vantaggi
Ferie: Possibilità di ferie supplementari se le 25-32 giornate annuali non bastano
GAV: Le condizioni di lavoro si basano sul contratto collettivo di lavoro (GAV) per il personale degli ospedali e cliniche bernesi
Cucina: Le cucine di Burgdorf e Langnau utilizzano prevalentemente prodotti stagionali, sani e locali. I collaboratori beneficiano di uno sconto e possono godere di una vasta scelta di buffet
Modernità, umanità e partecipazione attiva: Vogliamo essere un datore di lavoro moderno, creare un'atmosfera interpersonale positiva, in modo che i nostri collaboratori si sentano sempre al centro e a proprio agio
Eventi: Per promuovere la cultura aziendale offriamo un giorno libero. Colleghi da diverse sezioni possono partecipare a eventi come sci, ciclismo, funivia, escursioni, feste di Natale o eventi culturali
Sconto: Sul nostro intranet troverai informazioni/link a numerosi offerte attraenti e beneficerai di prezzi ridotti, ad esempio per piscina, cinema, auto o acquisti in farmacie regionali

Un giorno di prova offriamo la possibilità di vivere un giorno nella vita di una stazione psichiatrica. La formazione avviene in entrambi i siti (Burgdorf e Langnau). Non ti noierai qui: imparerai un mestiere vario, diversificato e significativo. Un team professionale ti accompagnerà e sosterrà nella tua formazione e ti aiuterà a sviluppare le tue capacità. Ai nostri apprendisti sono sempre presenti i formatori professionali e i colleghi esperti che ti sostengono in modo completo. Da subito sei un membro importante del team, noi ti prendiamo sul serio e siamo felici di accoglierti con entusiasmo. Lavori di notte o il fine settimana riceverai un credito di tempo e un supplemento salariale. Nell'Ospedale Emmental beneficerai di numerose agevolazioni attraenti come, ad esempio, da Zalando, Orell Füssli, Adidas, Dyson, Ochsner Shoes e molti altri.

en.title: Apprenticeship as Health Professional EFZ in Psychiatry (a)
en.description:
The Psychiatry department of Spital Emmental offers challenging positions for doctors, psychologists, nursing professionals, social workers, and administrative staff with opportunities for personal development and consideration of their own resources. In our manageable environment, the personality of each individual employee shapes how we interact and collaborate with each other. We value individuality as an enrichment. We offer positions at the two locations Burgdorf and Langnau. We are a successful training institution of the BZ Pflege.

Starting with the summer 2027 apprenticeship start, we offer positions at our Burgdorf and Langnau locations:

The Psychiatry department of Spital Emmental offers challenging positions for doctors, psychologists, nursing professionals, social workers, and administrative staff with opportunities for personal development and consideration of their own resources. In our manageable environment, the personality of each individual employee shapes how we interact and collaborate with each other. We value individuality as an enrichment. Positions are available at the two locations Burgdorf and Langnau. We are a successful training institution of the BZ Pflege.

Starting with the summer 2027 apprenticeship start, we offer positions at our Burgdorf and Langnau locations:

Your tasks
• As a Health Professional in Psychiatry, you accompany our patients and involve their families
• You perform varied tasks in the areas of activation, everyday life and relationship management, nursing, hospitality, and administration, and support people with mental health conditions according to their needs and situations in daily life
• For example, you assist with daily body care, getting up, dressing, shopping, cooking, or in the management of their daily lives
• You perform medical technical tasks such as measuring blood pressure, pulse, and temperature, blood draws, and administering medications

What you bring
• You must be at least 17 years old at the start of the apprenticeship
• You have a high degree of empathy, a respectful attitude, and good communication skills
• You enjoy working in a team and have a high sense of responsibility
• You have good English knowledge (though primarily Swiss context, ensure practical relevance in a Swiss setting)
• You are flexible and are willing to undertake part of the training in Burgdorf or Langnau

Your benefits
• Holidays: Additional vacation days if the annual 25-32 days are insufficient
• GAV: Our employment conditions are based on the collective labor agreement (GAV) for the staff of Bernese hospitals and clinics
• Culinarian: Our kitchens in Burgdorf and Langnau use largely seasonal, healthy, and local products. Staff benefit from a discount and can enjoy a wide variety of buffet options. Microwaves for self-brought food are also available.
• Modern, Human, and Engaged: We aim to be a modern employer, create a good interpersonal atmosphere so that our staff always feel central and at ease.
• Events: To promote our corporate culture, we offer a free day. Colleagues from various departments can participate in events like skiing, cycling, funicular, hiking, winter markets, or cultural events.
• Discounts: On our intranet, you will find information/links to numerous attractive offers and benefit from reduced prices, for example, at swimming pools, cinemas, cars, or purchases in regional pharmacies.

A trial day allows you to experience a day in the life of a psychiatric ward. Training takes place at both locations (Burgdorf and Langnau). You won’t get bored here: you’ll learn a varied, diverse, and meaningful profession. A professional team supports and accompanies you throughout your training and helps you develop your skills. Our trainees always have the support of professional mentors and experienced colleagues.

From the start, you are an important team member; we take you seriously and are excited to welcome you.
• Working evenings or weekends earns you time credits and wage supplements.
• At Spital Emmental, you benefit from various attractive perks, such as discounts at Zalando, Orell Füssli, Adidas, Dyson, Ochsner Shoes, and many more.

For further inquiries or an initial information meeting, please contact Bernhard Reusser, Head of Training in Psychiatry, at 034 421 29 74. We look forward to your contact.

Vos missions
• En tant que Professionnel(le) de la santé en psychiatrie, vous accompagnez nos patient(e)s et impliquez leurs proches
• Vous effectuez des tâches variées dans les domaines d’activation, de gestion du quotidien et des relations, de soins, d’hôtellerie et d’administration et soutenez les personnes atteintes de troubles mentaux selon leurs besoins et situations dans la vie quotidienne
• Par exemple, vous aidez au soin quotidien du corps, au lever, au vêtement, aux courses, à la cuisine ou dans la gestion de leur quotidien

Dein Aufgabengebiet
In dieser verantwortungsvollen Führungsfunktion übernimmst du gemeinsam mit unserer langjährigen Co-Abteilungsleiterin die fachliche, personelle und organisatorische Leitung des Pflegeteams der Intensivstation. Du stellst eine professionelle, patientenorientierte und qualitativ hochstehende Intensivpflege sicher und förderst zugleich die fachliche Entwicklung, die interprofessionelle Zusammenarbeit sowie das Wohlbefinden deiner Mitarbeitenden in einem anspruchsvollen und dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld. Mit deinem Engagement prägst du eine Pflegekultur, die auf Qualität, Sicherheit, Wertschätzung und Patientenzentrierung basiert.
• Du stellst eine professionelle, sichere und patientenorientierte Pflege gemäss unserem Pflegeleitbild sowie dem Konzept Skill- und Grademix sicher
• Du führst deine Mitarbeitenden fachlich, personell und organisatorisch zielorientiert und stärkst sie in ihrer Eigenverantwortung. Dabei bist du mitverantwortlich für den Stellenplan sowie für die Rekrutierung von neuen Mitarbeitenden
• Die gezielte Personalentwicklung liegt dir am Herzen: Du erkennst Potenziale, förderst Kompetenzen und begleitest dein Team in seiner fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
• Zudem behältst du das Abteilungsbudget im Blick und bringst dein betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis aktiv in die Führung der Abteilung ein
• Du förderst die interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit, wirkst aktiv im Tagesgeschäft mit und trägst dazu bei, eine konstruktive und lösungsorientierte Zusammenarbeit über Berufsgruppen hinweg zu gestalten
• Veränderungsprozesse begleitest du mit Weitblick und Engagement. Dabei beteiligst du dich aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung unserer Versorgungsprozesse

Das brauchst du um erfolgreich zu sein

• Du bist diplomierte/r Expertin / Experte Intensivpflege NDS HF und verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung
• Eine Managementausbildung auf Stufe NDS oder CAS bringst du bereits mit oder du bist bereit, diese zu absolvieren
• Idealerweise konntest du bereits Führungserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Funktion sammeln
• Du überzeugst durch Engagement, Eigeninitiative sowie eine ausgeprägte Fach- und Sozialkompetenz
• Dein Führungsstil ist geprägt von Respekt, Wertschätzung und einem klaren Fokus auf patientenzentriertes Handeln
• Du denkst vernetzt, handelst strukturiert und bringst ein gutes Verständnis für betriebliche Zusammenhänge mit
• Auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen bleibst du lösungsorientiert, gehst Konflikte konstruktiv an und stärkst die Zusammenarbeit sowie die Eigenverantwortung deiner Mitarbeitenden

en.title: Co-Departmental Head Nursing (a)
en.description:
Emmental Hospital ensures high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents across its two locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, 24 hours a day.

Nursing with heart, mind, and flexibility—welcome to Emmental Hospital. What sets us apart? As a versatile peripheral hospital with heart and mind, we live in a trusting work environment characterized by openness, respect, and appreciation.

Working modernly for us means acting humanely, with ample room for maneuver, and with an open ear for each other. Our employees are right in the thick of things—both professionally and personally. Family-friendly conditions and collaboratively designed schedules are part of our daily life.

For our interdisciplinary intensive care unit with 6 beds and 3 ventilator beds at the Burgdorf location, we are looking for a Co-Departmental Head Nursing starting August 1, 2026 or upon agreement:

Emmental Hospital ensures high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents across its two locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, 24 hours a day.

Nursing with heart, mind, and flexibility—welcome to Emmental Hospital. What sets us apart? As a versatile peripheral hospital with heart and mind, we live in a trusting work environment characterized by openness, respect, and appreciation.

Working modernly for us means acting humanely, with ample room for maneuver, and with an open ear for each other. Our employees are right in the thick of things—both professionally and personally. Family-friendly conditions and collaboratively designed schedules are part of our daily life.

Your professional tasks
In this responsible leadership role, alongside our experienced Co-Departmental Head Nursing, you will take on the professional, personnel, and organizational leadership of the nursing team in the intensive care unit. Ensure high-quality, patient-centered care according to our nursing philosophy and the Skill- and Grademix concept, while simultaneously fostering professional development, interdisciplinary collaboration, and the well-being of your team in a demanding and dynamic work environment. With your engagement, you shape a nursing culture based on quality, safety, appreciation, and patient-centeredness.
• Ensure professional, safe, and patient-centered care according to our nursing philosophy and Skill- and Grademix concept
• Lead your team professionally, personally, and organizationally, strengthening their autonomy. You are also responsible for staffing planning and recruitment of new employees
• Professional development is a priority for you: you recognize potential, foster competencies, and guide your team in their professional and personal development
• Monitor the departmental budget and actively bring your economic understanding into departmental leadership
• Foster interdisciplinary collaboration, actively participate in daily operations, and contribute to building a constructive and solution-oriented collaboration across professions
• Accompany change processes with foresight and engagement. Actively participate in the development and optimization of our care processes

What you need to succeed
• You are a diploma holder in Intensive Care Nursing NDS HF with extensive professional experience
• You already possess a management training at NDS or CAS level or are ready to pursue it
• Ideally, you have already gained leadership experience in a similar role
• You stand out for your commitment, initiative, and developed technical and social competencies
• Your leadership style is characterized by respect, appreciation, and a clear focus on patient-centered action
• You think in a networked way, act structuredly, and have a good understanding of corporate contexts
• Even in demanding situations, you remain solution-oriented, address conflicts constructively, and strengthen collaboration and autonomy of your team members

Our offer
Ferias: ¿Hay planes especiales de ferias? Si las 25 a 32 días de vacaciones anuales no son suficientes, podemos evaluar un período de vacaciones no remuneradas. Además, nuestros colaboradores recibirán un día libre en su día de cumpleaños.

Modernidad, humanidad y participación: Queremos ser un empleador moderno, crear una atmósfera interpersonal positiva, para que nuestros colaboradores siempre se sientan en el centro y cómodos.
Parking: Los colaboradores pueden utilizar varios estacionamientos según el lugar. El acceso y el pago se realizan mediante la tarjeta Parkingpay.
Eventos: Para fomentar nuestra cultura corporativa, ofrecemos a nuestros colaboradores un día libre. Colaboradores de diferentes áreas pueden participar en eventos como esquí, ciclismo, teleférico, senderismo, mercados navideños o culturales.

it.description:
La Gruppo Pratica Emmental AG è una società del Spedale Emmental e gestisce studi medici di famiglia a Langnau, Bärau e dal luglio 2025 nuovamente a Burgdorf. La pratica medica di famiglia a Burgdorf offre una assistenza a lungo termine e riduce il carico sul centro di emergenza attraverso la gestione di pazienti Fast-Track. La stretta collaborazione con i dipartimenti dello Spedale supporta una assistenza coordinata e ottimale. Il nostro team medico si sta ampliando e quindi cerchiamo: per la pratica medica di famiglia a Burgdorf a partire dal 1° ottobre 2026 o secondo accordo.

La Gruppo Pratica Emmental AG è una società del Spedale Emmental e gestisce studi medici di famiglia a Langnau, Bärau e dal luglio 2025 nuovamente a Burgdorf. La pratica medica di famiglia a Burgdorf offre una assistenza a lungo termine e riduce il carico sul centro di emergenza attraverso la gestione di pazienti Fast-Track. La stretta collaborazione con i dipartimenti dello Spedale supporta una assistenza coordinata e ottimale. Il nostro team medico si sta ampliando e quindi cerchiamo:

Il tuo ruolo – dinamico e vario

• Sei il punto centrale nella nostra routine quotidiana della pratica.
• Organizzi e triaggi le visite specialistiche e assicurati un flusso fluido e organizzato.
• Al ricevimento e al telefono sei una persona di riferimento – cortese, competente e orientata alla soluzione.
• Assisti i nostri pazienti con competenza: ECG, controlli dei segni vitali, prelievi di sangue, controlli di urina, iniezioni e infusioni, con il laboratorio Zybio.
• Aiuti il medico nei suoi compiti e in piccoli interventi chirurgici.
• Rediggi fatturazioni secondo Tardoc e supporti in varie attività amministrative.
• Ti impegni attivamente nella creazione, implementazione e miglioramento dei processi e delle procedure nella crescita della pratica.

Il tuo profilo – competente e umano

• Possiedi una formazione conclusa come MPA, preferibilmente con esperienza professionale.
• Sei una persona simpatica e che fiorisce nel lavoro di squadra.
• L’apertura mentale, la flessibilità e i valori umani sono importanti per te.
• La collaborazione costruttiva e orientata alla soluzione, anche interdisciplinare, è per te una cosa naturale.
• Risolvi i conflitti in modo orientato alla soluzione, aperto e riflessivo.
• Comunichi in modo valutativo, rispettoso e adeguato.
• Ci piacerebbe se il tuo team potesse beneficiare di una portata sana di humor.
• Hai un buon uso delle varie applicazioni PC.

Il nostro offerta
Ferie: Piani feriali speciali? Se le 25-32 giornate di ferie annuali non bastano, possiamo valutare un periodo di assenza non retribuito. Inoltre, per il tuo compleanno riceverai un giorno libero aggiuntivo!

GAV: Le condizioni di lavoro si basano sul Contratto Collettivo di Lavoro (GAV) per il personale degli ospedali e cliniche della Berna.

Culinario: Le nostre cucine a Burgdorf e Langnau utilizzano prevalentemente prodotti stagionali, sani e locali. I dipendenti beneficiano di uno sconto e possono godere di una vasta scelta di buffet. Disponibile anche una microonde per cibo da portare con sé.

Modernità, umanità e partecipazione attiva: Vogliamo essere un datore di lavoro moderno e creare un ambiente lavorativo interpersonale positivo, in modo che i nostri dipendenti si sentano sempre al centro delle cose e a proprio agio.

Parcheggio: I dipendenti possono utilizzare vari parcheggi a seconda dello specifico luogo. L’accesso e la gestione avvengono tramite la carte Parkingpay.

Eventi: Per promuovere la nostra cultura aziendale, offriamo un giorno libero per i nostri dipendenti. Colleghi provenienti da diverse sezioni possono partecipare a giorni dedicati allo sci, alla bicicletta, al pendolo, alla camminata, al divertimento, al mercato di Natale o a eventi culturali.

Sconto: Sul nostro intranet troverai informazioni/links a numerosi offerte attraenti e beneficerai di prezzi ridotti, ad esempio per piscina, cinema, auto o per acquisti in farmacie regionali.

Il nostro offerta – cosa ti aspettiamo da noi
Offriamo un lavoro stimolante e vario con possibilità di sviluppo professionale e crescita personale. Lavori in un team collaborativo e impegnato, caratterizzato da apprezzamento e vera collaborazione. In aggiunta, ti aspettano condizioni attraenti: retribuzione attraente e moderne condizioni di lavoro che ti supportano.

Spazio di gestione: Prendi responsabilità, subito o gradualmente. Sviluppa attivamente la tua posizione.

Sviluppo personale e professionale: Promuoviamo la tua formazione e ti sostitiamo nel tuo percorso professionale. Se ti piace lavorare con compiti vari, essere autonomo e far parte di un team dinamico, allora sei nel posto giusto per noi! Esercitati sia da neolaureato, come rientrante o come nuovo arrivato, siamo lieti di conoscerti!

Per domande, non esiti a contattarci.

en.description:
The Emmental Medical Practice AG is a company of Emmental Hospital and operates family medicine clinics in Langnau, Bärau, and since July 2025 again at the Burgdorf location. The Emmental Medical Practice AG is a company of Emmental Hospital and operates family medicine clinics in Langnau, Bärau, and since July 2025 again at the Burgdorf location. The Burgdorf family medicine clinic enables long-term general medical care and reduces the load on the emergency center by handling Fast-Track patients. Close collaboration with the hospital’s departments supports coordinated and optimal care. Our medical team is expanding, so we are seeking:

Your Role – Diverse and Dynamic

• You are the central hub in our daily practice routine.
• You organize and triage appointments and ensure a smooth, structured workflow.
• At reception and on the phone, you are a key point of contact—friendly, competent, and solution-oriented.
• You provide expert care to our patients: ECG, vital sign checks, blood draws, urine tests, injections, infusions, and Zybio lab services.
• You assist the doctor in their duties and minor surgical procedures.
• You prepare billing according to Tardoc and support various administrative tasks.
• You actively contribute to the design, implementation, and improvement of processes and workflows in the practice’s growth.

Your Profile – Expert and Human-Centered

• You have a completed MPA training, preferably with professional experience.
• You are a sympathetic person who thrives in teamwork.
• Openness, flexibility, and human values are important to you.
• Constructive, solution-oriented collaboration, even interdisciplinary, is natural to you.
• You resolve conflicts solution-oriented, openly, and reflectively.
• You communicate fairly, respectfully, and appropriately.
• We’d love if you could enrich our team with a healthy dose of humor.
• You have a proficient use of various PC applications.

Our Offer

Ferias: Special vacation plans? If the annual 25 to 32 vacation days don’t suffice, we can explore the possibility of an unpaid leave. Additionally, for your birthday, you’ll receive an extra free day!

GAV: Our employment conditions are based on the Collective Labor Agreement (GAV) for personnel of Bernese Hospitals and Clinics.

Culinary: Our kitchens in Burgdorf and Langnau use seasonal, healthy, and local products. Employees benefit from a discount and can enjoy a diverse buffet selection. Microwaves for self-brought food are also available.

Modernity, Humanity, and Active Participation: We want to be a modern employer and create a positive interpersonal atmosphere, so that our employees always feel centered and at ease.

Parking: Employees can use various parking lots depending on the location. Access and billing are handled via the Parkingpay card.

Events: To promote our corporate culture, we offer a free day for our employees. Colleagues from various departments can participate in skiing, biking, funicular, hiking, fun, Christmas market, or cultural events.

Discounts: On our intranet, you’ll find information/links to numerous attractive offers and benefit from reduced prices, e.g., at indoor pools, cinemas, cars, or purchases in regional pharmacies.

Our Offer – What Can We Expect from You?

We offer a stimulating and diverse work environment with opportunities for professional development and personal growth. You’ll work in a collaborative, engaged team characterized by appreciation and genuine teamwork. Additionally, you’ll find attractive conditions: competitive salary and modern working conditions that support you.

Design Space: Take on responsibility, immediately or gradually. Actively shape your role.

Personal and Professional Development: We promote your training and support your career progression. If you enjoy diverse tasks, work independently, and want to be part of a dynamic team, then you’re the right fit for us! Whether you’re fresh out of training, a re-entrant, or a newcomer, we’re excited to meet you!

For questions, feel free to reach out.

La Groupe Pratique Emmental AG est une entreprise du Hôpital Emmental et gère des cabinets de médecine générale à Langnau, Bärau et depuis juillet 2025 à nouveau au siège de Burgdorf. • Vous êtes le point central dans notre routine quotidienne du cabinet.
• Vous organisez et triagez les consultations et assurez un déroulement fluide et structuré.
• Au bureau d’accueil et au téléphone, vous êtes une personne de contact importante – courtoise, compétente et orientée vers la solution.
• Vous prenez en charge nos patient·e·s avec expertise : ECG, contrôles des signes vitaux, prélèvements sanguins, contrôles d’urine, injections et infusions, avec le laboratoire Zybio.
• Vous soutenez le médecin dans ses tâches et lors de petites interventions chirurgicales.
• Vous rédigez les factures selon le modèle Tardoc et soutenez diverses tâches administratives.
• Vous vous impliquez activement dans la création, la mise en œuvre et l’amélioration des processus et des flux de travail dans la croissance du cabinet.

Votre profil – compétent et humain

• Vous avez une formation terminée en MPA, idéalement avec une expérience professionnelle.
• Vous êtes une personne agréable et qui prospère dans le travail d’équipe.
• L’ouverture d’esprit, la flexibilité et les valeurs humaines sont importantes pour vous.
• La collaboration constructive et orientée vers la solution, même interdisciplinaire, est naturelle pour vous.
• Vous résolvez les conflits orientée vers la solution, ouverte et réfléchie.
• Vous communiquez sans jugement, avec respect et de manière appropriée.
• Nous serions ravis de voir notre équipe enrichie d’une portion saine d’humour.
• Vous avez une maîtrise avancée des diverses applications informatiques.

Jours de congé: Plans de congés spéciaux? Si les 25 à 32 jours de congé annuels ne suffisent pas, nous pouvons examiner la possibilité d’un congé non rémunéré. De plus, pour votre anniversaire, vous recevrez un jour de congé supplémentaire!

GAV: Nos conditions de travail sont principalement régies par le Contrat collectif de travail (GAV) pour le personnel des hôpitaux et cliniques de la région de Berne.

Culinaire: Nos cuisines à Burgdorf et Langnau utilisent principalement des produits locaux, saisonniers, sains et frais. Les employé·e·s bénéficient d’une réduction et peuvent se régaler d’une large sélection de buffets. Des micro-ondes pour les repas apportés par soi-même sont également disponibles.

Modernité, humanité et participation active: Nous voulons être un employeur moderne et créer une atmosphère interpersonnelle positive, afin que nos employé·e·s se sentent toujours au cœur des choses et à l’aise.

Parking: Les employé·e·s peuvent utiliser divers parkings selon le lieu. L’accès et la facturation se font via la carte Parkingpay.

Événements: Pour promouvoir notre culture d’entreprise, nous offrons un jour de congé pour nos employé·e·s. Les collègues issus de différentes sections peuvent participer à des journées de ski, de vélo, de télécabine, de randonnée, de divertissement, de marché de Noël ou d’événements culturels.

Réductions: Sur notre intranet, vous trouverez des informations/liens vers de nombreuses offres attractives et bénéficiez de tarifs réduits, par exemple pour les piscines, les cinémas, les voitures ou les achats en pharmacies régionales.

Notre offre – ce que nous vous attendons

Nous vous proposons un environnement de travail stimulant et varié avec des opportunités de développement professionnel et de croissance personnelle. Vous travaillerez dans une équipe collégiale et engagée, marquée par l’appréciation et une véritable collaboration.

Si vous aimez les tâches variées, travailler de manière autonome et faire partie d’une équipe dynamique, alors vous êtes chez nous tout à fait à votre place! Que vous soyez fraîchement diplômé·e, en reconversion professionnelle ou en reconnexion, nous sommes ravis de vous rencontrer!

Pour notre unité de soins intensifs interdisciplinaire avec 6 lits et 3 places de ventilation sur le site de Berthoud, nous recherchons quelqu'un à partir du 1er août 2026 ou sur rendez-vous. Votre domaine de responsabilité Dans ce rôle de direction responsable, vous assumerez la gestion technique, du personnel et de l'organisation de l'équipe de soins infirmiers de l'unité de soins intensifs en collaboration avec notre co-chef de service de longue date. Vous assurez des soins intensifs professionnels, axés sur le patient et de qualité tout en favorisant le développement professionnel, la collaboration interprofessionnelle et le bien-être de vos collaborateurs dans un environnement de travail exigeant et dynamique. Grâce à votre engagement, vous façonnerez une culture de soins basée sur la qualité, la sécurité, l’appréciation et l’attention portée au patient. • Vous assurez des soins professionnels, sûrs et axés sur le patient, conformément à nos principes infirmiers et au concept de mixité de compétences et de niveaux. • Vous dirigez vos collaborateurs de manière ciblée en termes de compétences, de personnel et d'organisation et renforcez leur responsabilité personnelle. Vous êtes coresponsable du plan d'effectif ainsi que du recrutement de nouveaux employés. • Le développement ciblé du personnel vous tient à cœur : vous reconnaissez le potentiel, valorisez les compétences et soutenez votre équipe dans son développement professionnel et personnel. • Vous surveillez également le budget du département et apportez activement votre compréhension des affaires dans la gestion du département. Vous participerez activement au développement et à l'optimisation de nos processus de soins. Ce dont vous avez besoin pour réussir • Vous êtes un expert qualifié en soins intensifs NDS HF et avez plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle • Vous avez déjà une formation en gestion au niveau NDS ou CAS ou vous êtes prêt à la compléter • Idéalement, vous avez déjà acquis une expérience de gestion dans une fonction comparable • Vous impressionnez par votre engagement, votre initiative et vos solides compétences techniques et sociales • Votre style de leadership se caractérise par le respect, l'appréciation et une orientation claire sur l'action centrée sur le patient • Vous pensez en réseau, agissez en de manière structurée et avez une bonne compréhension des contextes opérationnels • Même dans des situations exigeantes, vous restez orienté vers les solutions, abordez les conflits de manière constructive et renforcez la coopération et la responsabilité personnelle de vos collaborateurs. The Emmental Hospital provides high-quality medical care to 150,000 residents across its two hospital sites in Burgdorf and Langnau, 24 hours a day.

• Sei diplomata infermiera professionale (HF/FH) o quasi a termine e hai preferibilmente già esperienza nella cura d'urgenza
• La vasta gamma medica di un ospedale periferico familiare ti sembra affascinante e arricchente
• Incontri le persone con rispetto e considerazione, poiché la migliore assistenza possibile per i nostri pazienti è la tua priorità
• Lavori con cura, meticolosamente e sei felice di assumerti responsabilità

GAV: Le nostre condizioni di lavoro si basano principalmente sul contratto collettivo di lavoro (GAV) per il personale degli ospedali e delle cliniche della regione Berna.

Cucina: Le nostre cucine a Burgdorf e Langnau utilizzano prevalentemente prodotti stagionali, sani e locali. I collaboratori beneficiano di uno sconto e possono godere di una vasta scelta di buffet.

Modernità, umanità e partecipazione attiva: Vogliamo essere un datore di lavoro moderno, creare un'atmosfera interpersonale positiva, in modo che i nostri collaboratori si sentano sempre al centro delle cose e a proprio agio.

Parcheggio: I collaboratori possono utilizzare vari parcheggi a seconda del sito. L'accesso e la fatturazione avvengono tramite la carta di parcheggio Parkingpay.

Eventi: Per promuovere la nostra cultura aziendale, offriamo ai nostri collaboratori un giorno libero. Colleghi provenienti da diverse unità possono partecipare a un giorno dedicato allo sci, al ciclismo, al funivia, alla passeggiata, al divertimento, al mercato di Natale o a eventi culturali.

Sconti: Sul nostro intranet i nostri collaboratori trovano informazioni/links a numerosi offerte attraenti e beneficiano di prezzi ridotti, ad esempio per il bagno termale, il cinema, l'auto o per acquisti in farmacie regionali.

Sogno un "Kafi-Träff"? Prima di inviare la tua candidatura, puoi conoscerci in modo semplice e informale in un "Kafi-Träff" (cafè sociale). Ci faremo piacere di rispondere alle tue domande e farti un'idea del nostro team – tutto senza impegno.

Vuoi fare la differenza nella cura invece che eseguirla? Ci siamo entusiasti di te!

en.title: Registered Nurse (a)
en.description:
Right in the beautiful Emmental – your new challenge awaits you! The Emmental Hospital ensures high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents at its two hospital locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, 24 hours a day.

Caring with heart and responsibility – join our team! What makes us special? As a versatile peripheral hospital with heart and mind, we live in a trusting partnership and a work environment characterized by openness, respect, and appreciation.

Working modernly for us means acting humanely, with creative freedom and an open ear for each other. Our employees are right in the middle, both professionally and personally. Family-friendly conditions and a collaboratively designed schedule are part of our daily life.

For our medical department at the Burgdorf site, which has 33 beds and about 50 employees, students, and trainees, we are looking for a registered nurse (a) starting from July 1, 2026 or by agreement.

Right in the beautiful Emmental – your new challenge awaits you! The Emmental Hospital ensures high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents at its two hospital locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, 24 hours a day.

Caring with heart and responsibility – join our team! What makes us special? As a versatile peripheral hospital with heart and mind, we live in a trusting partnership and a work environment characterized by openness, respect, and appreciation.

For our medical department at the Burgdorf site, which has 33 beds and about 50 employees, students, and trainees, we are seeking a registered nurse (a) with a full-time contract (80-100%).

Shape nursing, strengthen people – your impact with us

• With autonomy and based on the latest nursing knowledge, you care for and provide care to our patients
• You take the lead of a nursing group and work closely with healthcare professionals, nursing assistants, students, and trainees
• You steer the entire nursing process, supported by our clinical information system Clinical, and ensure complete documentation
• Together with the team, continuously optimize nursing processes and bring your ideas to the table
• As a mentor, you guide and support students and trainees on their path into nursing

What you need to succeed

• You are a registered nurse (HF/FH) or nearly completed and have ideally already gathered experience in acute care
• The wide medical scope of a family-oriented peripheral hospital appeals to you as exciting and enriching
• You meet people with respect and appreciation, as the best possible care for our patients is your top priority
• You work meticulously, responsibly, and enjoy taking on responsibilities
• Continuous development is natural to you, and you want to continuously expand your skills
• You speak German fluently (B2 certification is required for non-native speakers)

Our offer

Vacation: Special vacation plans? If the annual 25 to 32 vacation days don’t suffice, we can explore the possibility of unpaid leave. Our employees also receive an additional free day on their birthday!

GAV: Our employment conditions are primarily based on the collective labor agreement (GAV) for the staff of Bernese hospitals and clinics.

Culinary: Our kitchens in Burgdorf and Langnau operate largely with seasonal, healthy, and local products. Employees benefit from discounts and can enjoy a wide variety of buffet options. Microwaves for self-brought items are also available.

Modern, human, and actively involved: We want to be a modern employer, create a positive interpersonal atmosphere so that our employees always feel right in the middle and comfortable.

Parking: Employees can use various parking lots depending on the location. Access and billing are handled via the Parkingpay card.

Events: To promote our corporate culture, we offer our employees a free day. Colleagues from various departments can participate in a skiing, cycling, chairlift, hiking, fun, Christmas market, or cultural event day.

Discounts: On our intranet, employees find information/links to numerous attractive offers and benefit from reduced prices, for example at the swimming pool, cinema, car, or in regional pharmacies.

Dream of a "Kafi-Träff"? Before sending in your application, you can get to know us informally at a "Kafi-Träff" (social coffee meeting). We’d be delighted to answer your questions and give you an insight into our team – completely without obligation.

Want to make a difference in nursing instead of just executing it? We’re excited to have you!

Further inquiries can be directed to Linda Blum, Co-Head of Nursing, phone 034 421 28 17 or Melanie Pelozzi, Co-Head of Nursing, phone 034 421 28 51.

Au cœur du beau canton de l'Emmental – votre nouvelle défi vous attend! L'Hôpital Emmental assure une excellente prise en charge médicale pour 150 000 habitants aux deux sites hospitaliers de Burgdorf et Langnau, 24 heures sur 24.

Shaper la prise en charge, renforcer les personnes – votre champ d'action chez nous

• Avec autonomie et selon les dernières connaissances en soins infirmiers, vous prenez soin de nos patientes et patients
• Vous assurez la direction d'un groupe de soins et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des professionnels de la santé, des auxiliaires de soins, des étudiantes et étudiants ainsi que des apprenants
• Vous dirigez le processus complet de soins, soutenu par notre système d'information clinique Clinical, et assurez une documentation complète
• Ensemble avec l'équipe, vous optimisez continuellement les processus de soins et apportez vos idées

Ce que vous devez pour réussir

• Vous travaillez soigneusement, méthodiquement et aimez prendre des responsabilités
• Le développement continu est naturel pour vous et vous souhaitez développer constamment vos compétences
• Vous maîtrisez parfaitement la langue allemande (une attestation B2 est requise pour les candidates et candidats étrangers)

GAV: Nos conditions d'emploi sont principalement régies par le contrat collectif de travail (GAV) pour le personnel des hôpitaux et cliniques de la région de Berne.

Cuisine: Nos cuisines à Burgdorf et Langnau fonctionnent principalement avec des produits saisonniers, sains et locaux. Modernité, humanité et implication active: Nous voulons être un employeur moderne, créer une atmosphère interpersonnelle positive, afin que nos collaborateurs se sentent toujours au cœur des choses et à l'aise.

Parking: Les collaborateurs peuvent utiliser divers parkings selon le site. L'accès et la facturation se font via la carte Parkingpay.

Événements: Pour promouvoir notre culture d'entreprise, nous offrons à nos collaborateurs un jour de congé. Des collègues de différentes unités peuvent participer à un jour dédié à la ski, au vélo, au télésiège, à la randonnée, au divertissement, au marché de Noël ou à des événements culturels.

Gestalte Pflege, stärke Menschen – dein Wirkungsfeld bei uns

• Du übernimmst Verantwortung für eine ganzheitliche, fachlich fundierte Pflege und begleitest unsere Patientinnen und Patienten mit Engagement und Herz
• Als Leitung einer Pflegegruppe führst du dein Team aus FaGe, Pflegeassistenzen, Studierenden und Lernenden mit Übersicht, Teamgeist und Fingerspitzengefühl
• Du steuerst den Pflegeprozess souverän – unterstützt durch unser digitales Klinikinformationssystem – und sorgst für eine präzise, nachvollziehbare Dokumentation
• Gemeinsam mit dem Team denkst du Pflege weiter: Du bringst Ideen ein, gestaltest Abläufe aktiv mit und entwickelst die Qualität stetig weiter
• Als Mentor:in begleitest und förderst du Studierende und Lernende auf deinem Weg in den Pflegeberuf

Das brauchst du um erfolgreich zu sein

• Du bist dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann (HF/FH) oder kurz vor Abschluss und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung in der Akutpflege gesammelt
• Die grosse medizinische Bandbreite eines familiären Peripheriespitals empfindest du als spannend und bereichernd
• Du begegnest Menschen mit Respekt und Wertschätzung, denn die bestmögliche Betreuung unserer Patientinnen und Patienten steht für dich an erster Stelle
• Du arbeitest sorgfältig, gewissenhaft und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung
• Weiterentwicklung ist für dich selbstverständlich und du möchtest deine Fähigkeiten stetig ausbauen
• Ein stilsicheres Deutsch rundet dein Profil ab (bei fremdsprachigem Diplom bringst du ein B2-Diplom mit)

Familienfreundliche Bedingungen und eine gemeinsam gestaltete Dienstplanung gehören bei uns zum gelebten Alltag. Für unsere chirurgische Abteilung mit 28 Betten – davon 8 in der Wochenklinik – suchen wir in Burgdorf per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als dipl. • Du bist dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann (HF/FH) oder kurz vor Abschluss und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung in der Akutpflege gesammelt
• Die grosse medizinische Bandbreite eines familiären Peripheriespitals empfindest du als spannend und bereichernd

Forma la cura, rinforza le persone – il tuo campo di azione per noi

Quali sono le tue competenze per essere un successo

• Sei diplomata/o in infermieristica professionale (HF/FH) o sei quasi a termine degli studi e hai preferibilmente già esperienza nella cura d'urgenza

• Lo sviluppo continua è per te una cosa naturale e vuoi sviluppare le tue capacità in modo costante

• Ferie

• Formazione e sviluppo professionale: Per noi crescere significa anche crescere insieme. Siamo aperti alla discussione dei nostri piani di carriera e desideri futuri.

• Cucina: Le nostre cucine a Burgdorf e Langnau utilizzano prevalentemente prodotti stagionali, sani e locali. I collaboratori beneficiano di uno sconto e possono godere di una vasta scelta di buffet.

• Parcheggio: I collaboratori possono utilizzare vari parcheggi a seconda della sede. L'accesso e il pagamento avvengono tramite carta di parcheggio Parkingpay.

Emmental Hospital provides high-quality medical care to 150,000 residents across its two locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, 24 hours a day.

Shape care, strengthen people – your field of action with us

• Vacations

• Collaboration in a multidisciplinary team, including day clinic and crisis intervention unit, with private practitioners and external institutions

• Enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork

Gemeinsam mit deinen engagierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen, Fachpersonen und externen Partnern gestaltest du die digitale Zukunft unseres Spitals – nah am Menschen, nah am Puls der Medizin. Insieme ai tuoi colleghi impegnati, alle persone competenti e ai partner esterni, contribuisci alla costruzione del futuro digitale della nostra ospedale – vicino alle persone, vicino al ritmo della medicina. Emmental Hospital ensures high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents around the clock at its two locations in Burgdorf and Langnau.

Shape the digital future of what moves people. Are you looking for more than just a job—an impactful mission? Then you’re in the right place! For our ICT team at the Burgdorf site, we are immediately or upon agreement hiring:

Your Impact Area
We are actively building our team and seeking motivated support. As ICT Applications Manager, you don’t just take on responsibility—you create real impact. Together with your engaged colleagues, experts, and external partners, you shape the digital future of our hospital—close to people and at the pulse of medicine. Your daily work is as diverse as our clinical operations—and equally meaningful.

• You are jointly responsible for the clinical information system (CGM Phönix) and ensure its stable operation together with the responsible medical informatician

• You analyze requirements, guide their implementation, and coordinate internal and external partners
• You actively participate in smaller projects, sub-projects, and larger initiatives
• You work closely with various departments, ICT infrastructure & services, ICT support, external vendors, and manufacturers
• You conduct tests, document changes, and ensure transparent processes
• You actively contribute to optimizing our application landscape in healthcare

What sets you apart:
• You have in-depth professional experience in the clinical environment and understand the processes, needs, and challenges of medical staff
• Terms like HL7, IHE, FHIR, DICOM are part of your daily routine, and you know how to integrate them into a hospital ICT environment
• You think in solutions, stay calm in storms, and enjoy connecting people, systems, and processes

Nous construisons activement notre équipe et recherchons un soutien motivé. En tant que Responsable ICT Applications, vous ne prenez pas seulement des responsabilités – vous créez un véritable impact. • Vous contribuez activement à l’optimisation de notre paysage d’applications dans le secteur de la santé

• Expérience dans le secteur de santé suisse et compréhension de l’environnement hospitalier
• Travail structuré et indépendant ainsi que la capacité de bien prioriser
• Expérience avec les processus ITIL (incident, demande, gestion des changements)

Emmental Hospital provides round-the-clock high-quality medical care to 150,000 residents across its two locations in Burgdorf and Langnau.

Care with heart, mind, and flexibility – welcome to Emmental Hospital. What sets us apart? As a versatile peripheral hospital with heart and mind, we foster a trusting partnership and a work environment characterized by openness, respect, and appreciation.

Working modernly for us means acting humanely, with ample room for maneuver and an open ear for each other. Our employees are right there with us, not just present—professionally and personally.

Family-friendly conditions and collaboratively designed schedules are part of our daily life. For our interdisciplinary emergency department in Langnau, we are looking for immediately or upon agreement:

Emmental Hospital provides round-the-clock high-quality medical care to 150,000 residents across its two locations in Burgdorf and Langnau.

Care with heart, mind, and flexibility – welcome to Emmental Hospital. What sets us apart? As a versatile peripheral hospital with heart and mind, we foster a trusting partnership and a work environment characterized by openness, respect, and appreciation.

Working modernly for us means acting humanely, with ample room for maneuver and an open ear for each other. Our employees are right there with us, not just present—professionally and personally.

Family-friendly conditions and collaboratively designed schedules are part of our daily life.

Your responsibilities – responsible and diverse:

• You care for our patients and their families in acute situations competently, empathetically, and professionally.
• You handle triage and holistic care in the emergency department.
• Together with the medical team, you plan the initial care for our acute patients.
• You coordinate further treatment in the interdisciplinary team.
• You work in a 24/7 shift system—flexibility is natural for you.

With you we have:
• A diploma in nursing HF/FH (or an equivalent foreign diploma recognized in Switzerland).
• Experience in acute care (particularly essential for nurses without NDS in emergency care).
• You are already an accredited Emergency Care Specialist or are interested in pursuing the post-diploma course in emergency care.
• You meet people with respect and empathy, as patient well-being is your top priority.
• You enjoy working in a team, are resilient, and responsible.

Our offer:
• Holidays: Special holiday plans? If the annual 25–32 days of holidays don’t suffice, we can explore the possibility of unpaid leave. Additionally, for your birthday, we offer an extra free day!
• GAV: Our employment conditions are based on the collective labor agreement (GAV) for the staff of Bern hospitals and clinics.
• Culinary: Our kitchens in Burgdorf and Langnau use seasonal, healthy, and local products. Employees benefit from discounts and can enjoy a varied buffet selection. Microwaves for self-brought meals are also available.
• Modern, Human, and Engaged: We aim to be a modern employer, fostering a positive interpersonal atmosphere so that our employees always feel right in the middle of things.
• Parking: Employees can use various parking lots depending on the location. Access and billing are handled via Parkingpay card.
• Events: To promote our corporate culture, we offer a free day. Colleagues from various departments can participate in events like skiing, cycling, funicular rides, hiking, fun fairs, Christmas markets, or cultural events.
• Discounts: On our intranet, employees will find information/links to numerous attractive offers and benefit from reduced prices, e.g., at indoor pools, cinemas, cars, or purchases in regional pharmacies.

Inquiries:
Are you flexible, engaged, and ready to take on new challenges? Then we are looking for you! Further information will be provided by Rebekka Messerli, Head of Emergency Department Langnau, phone 034 421 32 47, and Daniela Habegger, CNO, phone 034 421 28 02.

L'Hôpital Emmental assure une excellente prise en charge médicale aux 150 000 habitants des deux sites hospitaliers de Burgdorf et Langnau, 24 heures sur 24.

Soins avec cœur, esprit et flexibilité – bienvenue à l'Hôpital Emmental. Ce qui nous distingue ? En tant qu'hôpital périphérique polyvalent avec cœur et esprit, nous vivons une relation de confiance mutuelle et un climat de travail marqué par l'ouverture, le respect et la considération.

Travailler de manière moderne pour nous signifie agir de manière humaine, avec une grande liberté de manœuvre et une oreille ouverte les uns pour les autres. Nos collaborateurs sont avec nous, pas seulement présents – sur le plan professionnel et personnel.

Des conditions familiales et une organisation des horaires collaboratives font partie de notre quotidien. Pour notre station d'urgence interdisciplinaire à Langnau, nous recherchons immédiatement ou selon accord:

L'Hôpital Emmental assure une excellente prise en charge médicale aux 150 000 habitants des deux sites hospitaliers de Burgdorf et Langnau, 24 heures sur 24.

Soins avec cœur, esprit et flexibilité – bienvenue à l'Hôpital Emmental. Ce qui nous distingue ? En tant qu'hôpital périphérique polyvalent avec cœur et esprit, nous vivons une relation de confiance mutuelle et un climat de travail marqué par l'ouverture, le respect et la considération.

Travailler de manière moderne pour nous signifie agir de manière humaine, avec une grande liberté de manœuvre et une oreille ouverte les uns pour les autres. Nos collaborateurs sont avec nous, pas seulement présents – sur le plan professionnel et personnel.

Des conditions familiales et une organisation des horaires collaboratives font partie de notre quotidien.

Vos missions – responsables et variées:

• Vous accompagnez nos patientes et patients ainsi que leurs proches dans des situations aiguës de manière compétente, empathique et professionnelle.
• Vous assurez la triage ainsi que les soins globaux en station d'urgence.
• En collaboration avec l'équipe médicale, vous planifiez la prise en charge initiale de nos patientes et patients en situation aiguë.
• Vous coordonnez la suite des soins dans l'équipe interdisciplinaire.
• Vous travaillez en service 24/7 – la flexibilité est pour vous une évidence.

Avec vous, nous avons:
• Un diplôme en soins infirmiers HF/FH (ou un diplôme étranger équivalent reconnu en Suisse).
• Une expérience en soins d'urgence (en particulier indispensable pour les infirmières et infirmiers sans NDS en soins d'urgence).
• Vous êtes déjà expert(e) reconnu(e) en soins d'urgence ou vous êtes intéressé(e) par la possibilité de suivre le cours post-diplôme en soins d'urgence.
• Vous rencontrez les personnes avec respect et empathie, car le bien-être des patientes et patients est pour vous une priorité.
• Vous aimez travailler en équipe, êtes résilient(e) et responsable.

Notre offre:
• Vacances: Des plans de vacances spéciaux ? Si les 25 à 32 jours de vacances annuels ne suffisent pas, nous pouvons examiner la possibilité d'un congé non payé. De plus, pour votre anniversaire, nous offrons un jour supplémentaire de congé !
• GAV: Nos conditions d'emploi sont principalement régies par le contrat collectif de travail (GAV) pour le personnel des hôpitaux et cliniques de la région de Berne.
• Cuisine: Nos cuisines à Burgdorf et Langnau utilisent principalement des produits locaux, sains et de saison. Les collaborateurs bénéficient d'un tarif réduit et peuvent se régaler d'une large sélection de buffets. Des micro-ondes pour les repas apportés par soi-même sont également disponibles.
• Moderne, humain et engagé : Nous voulons être un employeur moderne, créer une atmosphère interpersonnelle positive, afin que nos collaborateurs se sentent toujours au cœur des choses.
• Parking: Les collaborateurs peuvent utiliser différents parkings selon le lieu. L'accès et le paiement sont gérés via la carte Parkingpay.
• Événements: Pour promouvoir notre culture d'entreprise, nous offrons un jour de congé. Les collègues de différentes sections peuvent participer à des événements comme la ski, vélo, télécabine, randonnée, fête de fin d'année, marchés culturels.
• Réductions: Sur notre intranet, les collaborateurs trouveront des informations/liens vers de nombreuses offres attractives et bénéficieront de prix réduits, par exemple pour la piscine couverte, le cinéma, la voiture ou les achats en pharmacies régionales.

Informations:
Vous êtes flexible, engagé(e) et prêt(e) à relever de nouveaux défis ? Alors nous cherchons exactement vous ! D'autres informations vous seront fournies par Rebekka Messerli, directrice de la station d'urgence Langnau, téléphone 034 421 32 47 et Daniela Habegger, CNO, téléphone 034 421 28 02.

it.description:
L'Ospedale Emmental garantisce un'alta assistenza medica a 150.000 residenti, 24 ore su 24, con specialisti e professionisti nei due siti di Burgdorf e Langnau. Assistiamo con cuore, intelligenza e flessibilità - benvenuti all'Ospedale Emmental. La nostra peculiarità? Come ospedale periferico variegato con cuore e intelligenza, viviamo un'atmosfera di fiducia e un clima di lavoro caratterizzato da apertura, rispetto e apprezzamento. Lavorare in modo moderno per noi significa agire in modo umano, con libertà di progettazione e un orecchio aperto gli uni verso gli altri. I nostri dipendenti sono al centro, sia professionalmente che personalmente. Le condizioni familiari e la pianificazione dei turni condivisa fanno parte della nostra vita quotidiana.

Stiamo cercando, a partire da subito o su accordo, un/una esperta/esperto di pronto soccorso o un/una diplomata in assistenza infermieristica (a) per la nostra stazione di pronto soccorso interdisciplinare presso il sito di Burgdorf.
requirements: Hai un diploma in assistenza infermieristica HF / FH (o diploma equivalente straniero riconosciuto in Svizzera)
Hai esperienza nella assistenza infermieristica acuta (soprattutto per gli infermieri senza NDS in pronto soccorso)

Lavori volentieri in team, sei resistente e responsabile

en.title: Diploma in Emergency Nursing or Diploma in Nursing (a)
en.description:
Emmental Hospital ensures high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents, around the clock, with specialists and professionals at the two sites in Burgdorf and Langnau. Nursing with heart, mind, and flexibility - welcome to Emmental Hospital. What sets us apart? As a varied peripheral hospital with heart and mind, we live in a trusting atmosphere and a work environment characterized by openness, respect, and appreciation. Modern working for us means acting humanely, with design freedom and an open ear for each other. Our employees are right in the middle, both professionally and personally. Family-friendly conditions and jointly planned shifts are part of our daily life.

We are looking for a diploma in emergency nursing or a diploma in nursing (a) for our interdisciplinary emergency station at the Burgdorf site, starting immediately or by arrangement.
requirements: You have a diploma in nursing HF / FH (or equivalent foreign diploma recognized in Switzerland)
You have experience in acute nursing (especially for nurses without NDS in emergency care)
You are already a recognized diploma in emergency nursing or have the opportunity to attend the post-diploma course in emergency nursing
You meet people with respect and empathy, as the well-being of the patients is your top priority
You work well in a team, are resilient, and responsible

Circa 120 dipendenti e più di 500 volontari aiutano in situazioni di emergenza, sono coinvolti nella formazione, promozione della salute e integrazione della popolazione a Baselbiet. Per il nostro supporto di reparto a casa stiamo guardando 01. Settembre 2026 o d'accordo un nuovo manager. I vostri compiti Chiedete la corretta e fluida gestione delle offerte del vostro reparto: « Rotkreuz-Notruf », « Pflege und Pflege » e « Familienloss» Si occupa della gestione tecnica, organizzativa e del personale del team "Supporto a casa" in ufficio (6 persone) e nel campo dei servizi esterni (60 persone). Tenere a mente i processi amministrativi e numeri del vostro dipartimento e fornire tutte le informazioni necessarie alla gestione. L'utente vi terrà nell'attuale ambiente di mercato, riconoscerà importanti sviluppi e porterà lo sviluppo strategico del dipartimento e, come membro della gestione, l'intero SRK BL. Siete ben collegati, comportatevi e unitevi a nuovi contatti e rappresentate il vostro reparto, così come la SRK BL in occasioni e in gruppi specializzati, dove state attivamente introducendo le nostre offerte. Il tuo profilo Hai una laurea come infermiera a livello terziario e esperienza Spitex. Hai completato una formazione nella gestione e nell'esperienza nella gestione del personale. Vivi una cultura di leadership che rafforza i vostri dipendenti, avere sempre un orecchio aperto per loro e vedere come una spina dorsale del vostro dipartimento. Avete acquisito una conoscenza ben fondata delle situazioni di vita delle persone all'età o con una malattia e delle famiglie e avete l'empatia necessaria nel trattare con questi gruppi. Le offerte per le persone vulnerabili nel campo della salute del cantone di Basilea-Landschaft sono a vostra conoscenza. Hai il piacere di affrontare diversi sistemi di chiamata di emergenza. Perché dovresti lavorare con noi: coltiviamo una cultura aziendale aperta che si caratterizza per rispetto e apprezzamento. Lei fa parte del consiglio di gestione a quattro teste, che, insieme al direttore esecutivo, forma e sviluppa la SRK BL sulla base dei suoi principi. Ci sono attualmente varie sfide pionieristiche nel vostro dipartimento che hanno bisogno del vostro contributo. Un team motivato e impegnato vi aspetta nel vostro dipartimento. Il luogo di lavoro è Liestal. Il team apprezza la vostra presenza in loco, ma naturalmente offriamo anche opportunità di lavoro flessibili. Sei disposto a fare una vera differenza e diventare parte della più grande organizzazione umanitaria in Svizzera? Allora non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione! Invia i tuoi documenti significativi via e-mail a personal@srk-baselland.ch . Hai delle domande? Per ulteriori informazioni, rivolgersi a Anja Nicole Seiwert, Responsabile Affari, Tel. 061 905 82 07 o Regina Bachmann, Divisione Personale, Tel. 061 905 82 10.

it.title: Sales Manager
it.description:
Mansioni

Il Sales Manager guida le prestazioni, l'engagement e lo sviluppo del team di vendita della boutique, garantendo che ogni interazione con il cliente rifletta i valori della Maison dell'eccellenza, generosità e curiosità. Come vero leader del personale e driver del business, il Sales Manager traduce la strategia di Cartier in azioni quotidiane - ispirando la squadra, massimizzando le prestazioni e offrendo un'esperienza clienti eccezionale che incarna lo spirito della Maison.

Responsabilità

- Animare le prestazioni e guidare dal piano di vendita
- Impostare, monitorare e tracciare i KPI di vendita individuali e collettivi per garantire il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di prestazione
- Guidare le rituali quotidiane e settimanali del business (riunioni, follow-up, sessioni one-to-one) con energia, focus e chiarezza
- Garantire l'eccellenza nell'esperienza del cliente e nelle operazioni di vendita al dettaglio, garantendo il rispetto e l'allineamento con gli standard della Maison
- Agire come leader del piano di vendita, mantenendo una presenza visibile e ispiratrice sul piano di vendita per guidare l'engagement, supportare le squadre e garantire il coaching in tempo reale
- Fornire feedback e guida attivi durante gli interazioni con i clienti per migliorare l'impatto delle vendite e la narrazione
- Collaborare strettamente con il Boutique Manager e il Operations Manager per garantire un'esecuzione senza intoppi della boutique e la coordinazione della squadra
- Sviluppare ed elevare la squadra
- Condurre le valutazioni delle prestazioni individuali, fornendo feedback regolari, coaching e opportunità di sviluppo
- Costruire e implementare i piani di sviluppo individuale (IDP) e i piani di gestione delle prestazioni (PMP) personalizzati per ogni Sales Associate
- Identificare e coltivare talenti, garantendo una forte pianificazione della successione all'interno della squadra
- Rafforzare la cultura del servizio di Cartier ancorando gli standard di eccellenza Chez Cartier in tutte le interazioni con i clienti
- Promuovere un mindset di apprendimento e favorire il miglioramento continuo
- Incoraggiare la collaborazione, la motivazione e il successo collettivo attraverso una comunicazione chiara e il riconoscimento
- Monitorare e analizzare i dati di soddisfazione del cliente (CER, FTR, CARE) per guidare le prestazioni e migliorare l'esperienza del cliente
- Supportare gli Sales Associate nello sviluppo e nella gestione dei loro portafogli clienti con un focus sulla fedeltà e la ritenzione
- Supervisionare i piani di clienteling e garantire un'azione di outreach personalizzata allineata con il profilo e le preferenze di ogni cliente
- Guidare le azioni di follow-up per rafforzare i rapporti con i clienti di Alta Gioielleria e VIC, garantendo un servizio su misura e attenzione
- Promuovere l'eccellenza nell'accoglienza e nell'esperienza del cliente all'interno della boutique
- Collaborare con il Client/CRM Manager per identificare opportunità di crescita e cross-selling
- Essere un ambasciatore della Maison di Cartier nella comunità locale, incarnando i valori della Maison con eleganza e fiducia
- Rafforzare i partenariati e costruire relazioni che migliorano la visibilità e la reputazione della boutique
- Partecipare agli eventi e alle iniziative locali che si allineano con l'immagine e lo spirito della Maison

Profilo

- Provenienza manageriale in un ambiente retail o di lusso dinamico
- Forte acume commerciale e leadership, in grado di ispirare e sviluppare squadre ad alte prestazioni
- Profonda comprensione delle aspettative dei clienti di lusso e dell'arte della costruzione di relazioni
- Leader con le mani, con una forte presenza sul piano di vendita, che guida l'esempio e motiva la squadra
- Eccellenti abilità comunicative, di coaching e di risoluzione dei problemi
- Almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale nel settore retail

Competenze

- Padronanza della gestione delle vendite e dei KPI del retail, garantendo la prestazione e l'allineamento strategico
- Forte leadership del piano di vendita e la capacità di coinvolgere le squadre in tempo reale per guidare i risultati
- Provenienza nell'engagement del cliente, con una comprensione della decisione basata sui dati
- Eccellenti abilità organizzative e analitiche per monitorare le prestazioni e ottimizzare i processi di vendita
- Solida conoscenza del business per tradurre gli obiettivi della boutique in iniziative azionabili
- Leadership ispiratrice che combina empatia, fiducia e assertività
- Eccezionali abilità comunicative e di coaching, che favoriscono la fiducia e l'empowerment all'interno della squadra
- Mentalità imprenditoriale con curiosità e adattabilità agli ambienti in cambiamento
- Approccio centrato sul cliente, radicata nella generosità, nell'autenticità e nell'eccellenza
- Spirito di squadra e atteggiamento collaborativo per guidare il successo collettivo

Requisiti

- Esperienza manageriale comprovata in un ambiente retail o di lusso dinamico
- Forte acume commerciale e leadership, in grado di ispirare e sviluppare squadre ad alte prestazioni
- Profonda comprensione delle aspettative dei clienti di lusso e dell'arte della costruzione di relazioni

Cosa offriamo

- Un ambiente stimolante per la crescita professionale e l'opportunità di contribuire alla visione individuale a un'eredità di creatività
- Riconosciamo ogni traguardo, grande o piccolo, favorendo connessioni significative attraverso la gratitudine e il supporto reciproco, che nutrono un senso di appartenenza
